summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of SECURE Waste Infrastructure Corp. under a previously announced arrangement agreement. The transaction was financed via revolving credit capacity, issuance of 75,126,306 GFL subordinate voting shares, and a new US$1 billion senior secured term loan maturing August 2033 at SOFR +200 bps (~5.0% after swaps). SECURE common shares will be delisted from the TSX on or about September 2, 2026. GFL expects enhanced scale, maintaining net leverage in the mid-3s, and will update 2026 guidance in Q3. Watch for integration execution and deleveraging progress toward investment grade.
